metadata.track_name: Add Excel integration and Web-IDE demos
metadata.goal: Add minimal Excel (.xls/.xlsx) import/export support usable from Web-IDE expressions and ship demos + tests.

phase.name: Scope & Dependency
phase.description: Finalize API surface and choose Excel library

task.name: Confirm Excel scope and API surface

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Review Java reference sources in ../src/main/java/com/scudata (T.java + XlsImport/XlsExport)
Decide T() only vs file().xlsimport/xlsexport (Java composes T() to xlsimport/xlsexport)
Decide options representation (object vs flags string), since TS has no @opt syntax
Workspace installs an Excel reader/writer library supporting .xls/.xlsx
Dependency is scoped to runtime package where feasible

phase.name: Excel Import
phase.description: Implement T() read for .xls/.xlsx and add tests

acceptance_criteria.criterion: T("*.xls") and T("*.xlsx") load first sheet with header row by default
Optional sheet selection supported (index or name)
Path traversal outside workspace root is rejected

subtask.name: Write failing tests for Excel import (.xls/.xlsx)

phase.name: Excel Export
phase.description: Implement T() write for .xls/.xlsx and add tests

acceptance_criteria.criterion: T("out.xls", data) and T("out.xlsx", data) write a row-wise sheet
Export returns the output path string

subtask.name: Write failing tests for Excel export (.xls/.xlsx)

phase.name: Web Server & Demo Data
phase.description: Stabilize workspaceRoot and add demo .xls/.xlsx fixtures

phase.name: Web-IDE Demos
phase.description: Add Excel import/export demos and update e2e if needed

phase.name: Validation
phase.description: Run tests, coverage, and codument validation
